Master of Business Administration in Executive Management

Lead the future of business with an MBA designed for the next generation of professionals.

Whether you’re ready to earn a promotion, transition into leadership, or build the skills today’s employers are looking for, the Master of Business Administration in Executive Management is designed to help you get there.

Built for ambitious professionals, CIAM’s MBA combines practical, real-world learning with leadership development, strategic thinking, and hands-on business application—giving you the confidence to lead teams, solve complex challenges, and make a lasting impact.

Customize your experience with fully online or hybrid learning options, complete your degree in one or two years, and choose a concentration in Business Analytics or Project Management to align with your career goals.

Your next opportunity won’t wait. Invest in the skills that help you stand out, lead with purpose, and move your career forward.

About CIAM

The California Institute of Advanced Management (CIAM) is the first independent, nonprofit graduate school entirely dedicated to advancing a more balanced and just society through responsible business management principles. At CIAM, we believe business has the power to shape the world—and the future belongs to leaders who combine knowledge, ethics, and compassion.

While many graduate schools only teach theoretical concepts, CIAM prepares students for both the practical and theoretical elements that the world needs today. Our business university in California offers working students a chance to enroll in innovative hybrid distance education courses that are convenient and affordable.
